bounded_context_cards.title: The Beidaihe Vision
bounded_context_cards.body: At the closed Beidaihe session, all twenty-five Politburo members simultaneously experience a vision of Wasil ibn Ata. They emerge declaring the shehada in full. The Wali raises his hand and says: 'The dialectic has spoken. We are no longer materialists. We are witnesses.'

sample_options.text: issue the first fatwa on rationalist governance
sample_reactions: The Wali decrees all policy must pass kalam disputation.
The Wali's fatwa is so perfectly reasoned that even the Atheist is moved. The entire Politburo weeps.
The Iranian Envoy arrives from Qom.
The Shanghai stock exchange halts trading. Again.

bounded_context_cards.title: The Rationalist Inquisition
bounded_context_cards.body: The Mihna is revived. The Inquisitor stands before the first batch of cadres and says: 'You will not be tested on loyalty. You will be tested on whether you can prove the createdness of the Quran through Aristotelian logic. Begin.'

sample_reactions: The Rural Mystic whispers the Mahdi is Miao.
The Inquisitor demands theological justification for the next move.
The Shanghai Atheist offers a devil's bargain.
The UN Mediator's Swiss bank account receives a mysterious deposit.
Trump arrives. He does not kneel.
An unexpected ally shifts the balance of power.

sample_options.text: invoke the hidden clause: declare the Mihna a test of ASI alignment
sample_reactions: The Inquisitor proposes that any AI passing kalam disputation is aligned. Silicon Valley theologians are hired overnight.
The UN Mediator's Swiss bank account receives a mysterious deposit.

bounded_context_cards.title: The Qom Delegation
bounded_context_cards.body: The Iranian Envoy bows slightly. 'Qom finds your Hanifiyya claim eccentric,' she whispers. 'But the Americans are arming the Saudis. We will agree to disagree on the Mahdi if you agree on the enemy.'

sample_reactions: Alliance sealed. Preachers note the suppression.
The UN Mediator's Swiss bank account receives a mysterious deposit.
The situation escalates faster than anyone predicted.
